app.was_der_weg_zur_arbeit: What the trip to work costs, and how much of it is deductible.
app.die_staffel_zaehlt_die_einfache: The tiers count the one-way distance, not the round trip. The bar shows how your commute splits across the two rates.
app.dieselbe_strecke_fuenf_verkehrsmittel: Same route, five modes of transport
app.gramm_co_fuer_die_einfache: Grams of CO₂ for the one-way trip, using the German Environment Agency's average figures for Germany.
app.monat_fuer_monat_festhalten: Keep a record month by month
app.gespeichert_wird_der_aktuelle_monat: Saving records the current month with its distance, days and allowance. Saving again in the same month overwrites the entry.
app.oeffnet_in_einem_neuen_tab: Opens in a new tab. Once a start and destination are set, the first few links point straight at your route.

fkVerdictSay.setze_start_und_ziel_dann: Set a start and a destination, and this line will show what the commuter allowance adds up to over twelve months.

fkOfflineFallback.ohne_netz_gibt_es_weder: Without a connection there is no map and no routing. Enter the one-way distance by hand and the page will keep calculating.

fkMapSection.zwei_adressen_suchen_oder_direkt: Search two addresses or tap straight into the map. Distances follow real roads, not straight lines. If you drive a different way, drag the line onto your route.

fkMapHint.in_die_karte_tippen_setzt: Tapping the map sets a point. Markers can be dragged.

fkTierEmpty.ohne_strecke_gibt_es_nichts: No distance, nothing to split into tiers.

fkTierNote.die_pauschale_ist_ein_abzug: The allowance reduces taxable income, it is not a payout. What comes back depends on your tax rate.

fkCo2Note.sobald_eine_strecke_steht_stehen: The figures appear here as soon as a distance is set.

fkSaveHint.braucht_eine_strecke_und_mindestens: Needs a distance and at least one working day.

fkHistoryEmpty.noch_kein_monat_gespeichert_rechne: No month saved yet. Work out a route above and record it here.

fkFuelPrice.spritpreis_in_euro_je_liter: Fuel price in euros per litre

__metaDescription: Commuting-cost tracker with real routing, address search, public-transport links, fuel costs and the German commuter allowance. Completely free for apprentices.
